rebalance: last completed session of each calendar month signals; next session open executes
publication_lag: SEC filed date + 2 US weekdays, then next tradable open; weekends included in delay, holidays skip at execution
fundamental: TTM GAAP NetIncomeLoss, latest filed as-of each day; latest period diluted weighted shares, quarterly preferred at same period end, annual fallback for Q4; future split normalization applied to prices and shares consistently
implementation_clarification: Initial audit found false stale status in Q4 when excluding annual weighted shares; annual fallback added to repair coverage, not choose return-enhancing parameters. Weighted shares remain a proxy for market capitalization.
stale: latest profit period end older than 190 days or share period older than 190 days disables valuation entries and exits to cash on next monthly decision
valuation: trailing 1260-session historical PIT PE percentile, minimum 504 valid sessions; buy <=40th percentile; sell >=80th percentile; nonpositive/missing/stale earnings go to cash
drawdown: 252-session split-adjusted closing high; buy at >=20% drawdown; exit when drawdown <=5%; no stop loss
trend: close above 200-session simple moving average -> stock; otherwise cash
valuation_trend: entry requires valuation buy condition and trend positive; exit valuation sell condition or trend negative or missing valuation
cash: BIL ETF adjusted total-return open-to-open, includes fund distributions and embedded expenses; switching stock/BIL charges both legs
dividends: Yahoo adjusted open from adjusted-close/close factor; theoretical ex-date immediate reinvestment, do not add dividends twice
taxes: excluded; USD, no FX, no borrowing, no shorting
selection_bias: two user-selected current winners; no universe selection inference; pseudo OOS uses historical dates, not a prospective experiment
